blocking_failures: behavior_in_tests: The tests cover basic lookup, history, stats, reload, generated captures, persistence, and some errors, but do not test malformed JSON or incomplete requests, exact response schemas broadly, atomic concurrent generations, reload consistency, or the stated memory/concurrency requirements.

valid_failure_modes: The verifier requires apt network access and downloads uv from astral.sh at runtime, so a capable submission can fail because of external network availability rather than task skill; the tests also omit several required behaviors.
